ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 95 percent of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels restricted to distal tip anomalies and localized surface streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous blobs are concentrated at the far left and right distal tips. Minimal high-contrast mottle is detected on the primary lobe surfaces, which maintain a nearly uniform low-intensity mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extracted continuous linear boundary shows high-frequency, moderate-amplitude serration. The right distal edge exhibits larger, more irregular peaks compared to the more consistent saw-tooth profile of the left trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible trajectory of both lobes follows a convex mathematical curve upward from the central waterline toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast, roughly circular and irregular pixel clusters concentrated on the lateral terminal ends of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple sparse, low-pixel-width linear white streaks on the central and left lobe ventral surfaces, oriented primarily in a vertical-to-diagonal direction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization and associated scarring at both distal tips; possible irregular tissue loss/indentation on the outermost edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of sessile organisms (likely Coronula diadema) creating a highly unique, three-dimensional textured perimeter at the lobe extremities.
